pattern: ^SELECT ([A-Za-z]+) FROM .+ WHERE PetID IN \((SELECT PetID FROM Pets WHERE PetType = 'cat'\)|(SELECT PetID FROM Pets WHERE PetType = 'dog')\) INTERSECT SELECT StuID FROM Has_Pet
correction: Join the tables `student`, `has_pet`, and `pets` together based on the common `stuid` and `petid`. Use the INTERSECT operator after joining the three tables to find common records between students with cats and dogs as pets.

metadata.description: This rule identifies queries that use subqueries in the WHERE clause instead of joining tables properly.
